prompts.name: saludando
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PNG character asset for USFQ Explora university wayfinding app. Original Gastón pig companion, inspired by the reference images' oversized expressive eyes, friendly compact silhouette and soft toy 3D finish, not their owl or dragon anatomy. Character bible: warm pale blush pink round pear-shaped chubby pig, oversized round head fused naturally into compact body, broad protruding oval salmon-pink snout with exactly two small dark nostrils, tiny smiling mouth below, huge glossy dark espresso eyes with ivory sclera and two clean highlights, subtle rosy cheek blush, two triangular pig ears with one tip gently folded, short rounded arms ending in simple dark cocoa split hooves, two tiny cocoa foot hooves, a single curled pink tail visible at right. A small vivid university-red triangular neckerchief #E11B22 tied at the side with no print, no shirt. Soft matte velvety vinyl / very fine peach fuzz, NOT long furry hair, premium rounded 3D clay-toy illustration, broad soft upper-left studio key light, gentle ambient occlusion confined to character, gentle warm tone, restrained details, readable at 48 px. Maintain exact same design, facial proportions, scarf, hoof color, materials and upper-left light across the entire series. No horns, wings, scales, dragon anatomy, human fingers, lettering, logos, watermark, scenery, cast ground shadows, colored background, artificial checkerboard. Real transparent alpha. Square PNG canvas at least 1024x1024, preferably 1536x1536. Character fully inside safe margins, no cropping unless specified.
Asset type: MASTER identity and splash greeting, filename saludando.png. Pose: front-facing full body centered at x50%, occupies about 78% of canvas height. Pig's arm on viewer LEFT raised in a friendly wave, three-quarter open simple split hoof, other arm relaxed on viewer RIGHT, both feet planted at same baseline y87%. Both eyes fully open looking directly at viewer, joyful closed-mouth smile. Snout centered and readable. One single pig only, no props. Do not generate a collage, design board, labels or multiple poses. This is the canonical model for the entire set.
